Same injected account/transport/fresh provider only; exact three GSA URL/method pairs share existing ephemeral URLSession, redirect/auth/cookie/cache/system TLS/body-limit/cancel rules. Cancel/await the actual login task before clearPendingAuthentication or logout. Guard AppSession and UI operation identity so a completed older action cannot clear/publish over a newer one.
